name: Kiboujima no Satsujin
source:
A good company has gathered  on an isolated island, but one by one murders occur out of revenge. You need to find the culprit and do it fast.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vn-of-month-june-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一群优秀的公司聚集在一座孤岛上，但为了复仇却发生了一件又一件的谋杀案。你需要找到罪魁祸首并尽快采取行动。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vn-of-month-june-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
